hypothesis: JS applies redraw handling to queued getdir input, although C queued input jumps past redraw handling.
supportedSetup: Ordinary human Ranger starts adjacent to southeast closed door at seed 421081. BINDINGS=n:redraw,N:movesoutheast. #therecmdmenu, direction N, select a (Open the door). No wizard commands, injected state, object creation or movement setup.
expectedC: Queued southeast CMDQ_DIR maps to n then goto got_dirsym skips redraw. The rebound n is not a movement key, so cmdassist invalid-direction help appears.
observedJS: Queued direction maps to n, then unconditional redraw_cmd triggers repaint and a fresh direction prompt.
control: Remove only n:redraw, retaining N:movesoutheast and identical input. All 20 screens/cursors and 2978 RNG calls match.
targetResult: 20 screens/cursors, 2973 RNG calls match, but screen/cursor first differ at zero-based boundary 16 (menu a). C invalid direction help; JS In what direction?
scope: getdir queued direction versus prompted redraw distinction under valid bindings. Door internals are not analyzed; selection only supplies the queue. Not a claim about general key bindings or all queued commands.
discardedProbes: First setup led to an open doorway without queued direction. Another used a long player name whose startup More consumed the intended command. Both invalid probes are excluded from yield. Short name QDir makes the recorded entry path explicit.
